name: chart
useFor: Use to show volume over time (messages sent, calls, webhook deliveries) or a share (deliveries by status). Name and color each series in a ChartConfig, wrap the chart in ChartContainer, and add ChartTooltip and ChartLegend. Keep to five series; the colors follow the series order.
constraints: Gradients other than the area fade
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): muted labels, lilac rules, floating panels and the status colors
title: Chart
description: Line, area, bar and pie charts in SVG with lilac rules, 12px muted labels and a white floating tooltip.
